summary: A game loop repeats three steps every frame: update positions, check collisions, and draw. With turtle, screen.ontimer() schedules the next frame and screen.update() draws it.
notes: screen.tracer(0) turns off automatic drawing, so the ball does not flicker. screen.update() draws the whole frame at once.
screen.ontimer(game_loop, FRAME_MS) runs game_loop again after 16 ms. It does not block, so keys still work.
The paddle check compares distances between centers to half-widths added together: 50 + 10 across and 10 + 10 up and down.
pitfall: Using a while True: loop with time.sleep() instead of ontimer() freezes the window, because turtle never gets a chance to handle key presses or redraw.
shot_note: Mid-game, after holding the Left key.
